beginner.name: Staggered Push-up
beginner.description: Push-up with one hand slightly forward and one back. Builds unilateral pressing strength and core stability while training chest and arms.
beginner.beginnerTips: Keep hips square to the floor. Alternate which hand is forward each set.

beginner.name: Arm Circles
beginner.description: Shoulder mobility and endurance drill. Extend arms to the sides and draw controlled circles to warm up and strengthen the deltoids.
beginner.beginnerTips: Start with small circles and gradually enlarge them. Reverse direction halfway through the set.

beginner.name: Prone I Raise
beginner.description: Lie face down and lift straight arms overhead forming an I shape. Targets rear delts and upper back for posture and shoulder health.
beginner.beginnerTips: Keep thumbs pointing up. Squeeze shoulder blades at the top without shrugging.

beginner.name: Prone Cobra
beginner.description: Back extension hold lying face down. Lift chest and arms slightly to strengthen the lower back and glutes with minimal spinal compression.
beginner.beginnerTips: Lift only as high as comfortable. Hold 2–3 seconds and lower with control.

beginner.name: Dead Hang
beginner.description: Hang from a sturdy bar or ledge with arms straight. Builds grip, forearms, and decompresses the spine while preparing for pull-up strength.
beginner.beginnerTips: Pack shoulders down slightly. Start with 10–20 seconds and add time gradually.

beginner.name: Fist Plank Hold
beginner.description: High plank performed on closed fists. Increases wrist and forearm demand while maintaining core tension.
beginner.beginnerTips: Align wrists under shoulders. Stop if you feel sharp wrist pain.

beginner.name: Scapular Push-up
beginner.description: From a high plank, protract and retract the shoulder blades without bending elbows. Trains serratus and mid-back control for healthier pressing.
beginner.beginnerTips: Keep arms straight throughout. Move only at the shoulder blades.

beginner.name: Squat Pulse
beginner.description: Hold the bottom of a squat and pulse up and down a few inches. Builds quad and glute endurance without equipment.
beginner.beginnerTips: Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes. Use a shallow range if needed.

beginner.name: Frog Pump
beginner.description: Lie on your back with soles together and knees open. Drive hips up by squeezing glutes for high-rep glute activation.
beginner.beginnerTips: Do not arch the lower back excessively. Pause briefly at the top of each rep.

beginner.name: Curtsy Lunge
beginner.description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy position and return. Emphasizes glutes and outer hip stability.
beginner.beginnerTips: Keep front knee aligned over the ankle. Touch the back knee toward the floor lightly.

beginner.name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust
beginner.description: Upper back on the floor, feet flat, drive hips to full extension. One of the most effective glute builders without weights.
beginner.beginnerTips: Tuck chin slightly and push through heels. Squeeze glutes hard at the top.

beginner.name: Seated Calf Raise
beginner.description: Sit with knees bent at 90 degrees and lift heels off the floor. Targets soleus and gastrocnemius without a step.
beginner.beginnerTips: Pause at the top. Place hands on knees for light resistance if desired.

beginner.name: Heel Taps
beginner.description: Lie on your back, crunch up slightly, and alternate tapping heels to the floor. Trains abs with light oblique engagement.
beginner.beginnerTips: Press lower back gently into the floor. Move slowly—do not rush the taps.

beginner.name: Sit-up
beginner.description: Classic abdominal exercise. Curl torso up from the floor with feet anchored or bent, then lower with control.
beginner.beginnerTips: Exhale on the way up. If your neck strains, support your head lightly with your hands.

beginner.name: Standing Side Crunch
beginner.description: Stand tall and crunch sideways bringing elbow toward hip. Isolates obliques without lying on the floor.
beginner.beginnerTips: Keep hips level—avoid leaning the whole body. Contract the side you are crunching toward.

beginner.name: Broad Jump
beginner.description: Explosive forward jump landing softly in an athletic stance. Develops power in legs and spikes heart rate for conditioning.
beginner.beginnerTips: Swing arms for momentum. Bend knees on landing to absorb impact.

beginner.name: Boxer Shuffle
beginner.description: Rapid weight shifts side to side on the balls of the feet with light punches optional. Low-impact cardio finisher.
beginner.beginnerTips: Stay on the balls of your feet. Keep movements small and rhythm steady.

intermediate.name: Tempo Push-up
intermediate.description: Push-up with a slow 3-second lowering phase and explosive press up. Increases time under tension for chest and triceps.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Count three seconds down, one second up. Maintain a rigid plank throughout.

intermediate.name: Close-Hand Push-up
intermediate.description: Push-up with hands shoulder-width or slightly narrower. Shifts emphasis toward triceps while still loading the chest.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Keep elbows closer to the body than a standard push-up. Do not let hips sag.

intermediate.name: Body Saw
intermediate.description: From forearm plank, rock body forward and back using shoulders. Challenges core anti-extension and triceps endurance.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Move in a small range at first. Keep glutes engaged to protect the lower back.

intermediate.name: Bodyweight Good Morning
intermediate.description: Hands behind head, hinge at hips with a flat back, then return upright. Strengthens hamstrings, glutes, and erectors.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Push hips back as if closing a door with your glutes. Stop when torso is near parallel to the floor.

intermediate.name: Chin-Up Negative
intermediate.description: Underhand grip at the top of a chin-up, lower slowly for 3–5 seconds. Builds biceps and lat strength for full chin-ups.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Use a sturdy bar. Jump or step to the top position and control the descent.

intermediate.name: Reverse Grip Hang Hold
intermediate.description: Hang with underhand grip at the top of a chin-up position. Isometric hold for biceps and grip endurance.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Use a box to reach the top position if needed. Keep shoulders engaged, not fully relaxed.

intermediate.name: Renegade Row
intermediate.description: From a high plank, row one hand to the hip while balancing on the other. Combines core stability with back and bicep pulling.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Widen foot stance for stability. Prevent hips from rotating as you row.

intermediate.name: Sissy Squat Hold
intermediate.description: Lean back slightly while bending knees forward, keeping hips extended. Intense quad isolation using bodyweight only.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Hold a wall or door frame lightly for balance. Use a small range until strength improves.

intermediate.name: Sliding Hamstring Curl
intermediate.description: Lie on your back, heels on a towel or socks on smooth floor, curl heels toward glutes. Hamstring curl without machines.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Lift hips as you curl in. Control the slide back to start.

intermediate.name: Nordic Curl Negative
intermediate.description: Kneel with ankles anchored under a couch or partner, lower torso forward slowly, catch with hands. Advanced hamstring eccentric.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Keep hips extended. Lower only as far as you can control—use hands to assist at the bottom.

intermediate.name: Standing Glute Kickback
intermediate.description: Stand on one leg and drive the other leg straight back. Isolates glutes and improves hip extension strength.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Squeeze glute at end range. Hold a wall for balance if needed.

intermediate.name: Lateral Lunge Pulse
intermediate.description: Step wide to one side, stay low, and pulse in the bottom position. Targets quads, glutes, and inner thighs.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Keep the bent knee over the foot. Chest stays lifted throughout pulses.

intermediate.name: Knee Pull-In
intermediate.description: Seated or on hands, draw knees toward chest and extend legs. Dynamic ab exercise scaling from beginner to advanced.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Round lower back slightly as knees come in. Move slowly to avoid momentum.

intermediate.name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
intermediate.description: In high plank, drive knee toward opposite elbow. Adds rotation to mountain climbers for obliques and cardio.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Keep shoulders over wrists. Quality beats speed—alternate sides with control.

intermediate.name: Hollow Rock
intermediate.description: Hold hollow body position and rock forward and back slightly. Advanced anti-extension core drill popular in gymnastics training.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Master hollow hold first. Keep lower back pressed toward the floor.

intermediate.name: Sprawl
intermediate.description: Drop hips back, shoot legs out to plank, jump feet in, stand up. Burpee without the push-up—pure conditioning.
intermediate.beginnerTips: Step feet back one at a time if jumping is too intense. Stand fully between reps.

advanced.name: Typewriter Push-up
advanced.description: At the bottom of a push-up, shift body weight side to side before pressing up. Extreme chest and tricep tension with core demand.
advanced.beginnerTips: Stay low—move horizontally at the bottom only. Master archer push-ups first.

advanced.name: Archer Inverted Row
advanced.description: Under a table, row toward one hand with the other arm extended. Unilateral back and bicep strength without a pull-up bar.
advanced.beginnerTips: Keep body rigid. Pull chest to the working hand each rep.

advanced.name: Shrimp Squat
advanced.description: Single-leg squat reaching the back knee behind you while holding the rear foot. Advanced quad and balance challenge.
advanced.beginnerTips: Use a wall for balance. Progress from partial range to full depth over weeks.

advanced.name: Tuck Front Lever Hold
advanced.description: Hang from a bar, tuck knees, and depress shoulders to lift torso nearly horizontal. Advanced straight-arm back and core strength.
advanced.beginnerTips: Start with short tuck holds. Focus on pushing shoulders down away from ears.

advanced.name: Power Skips
advanced.description: Exaggerated skipping with explosive knee drive and arm swing. Develops single-leg power and high-intensity conditioning.
advanced.beginnerTips: Drive the opposite arm and leg together. Land softly on the ball of the foot.
